  title?: ReactNode; // Bold heading above `children`, inside the text column.
  titleTestId?: string;
  children: ReactNode;
  actions?: ReactNode; // Optional—additional buttons or elements to the right of the text (for example, "Neu laden").
  padded?: boolean; // Adds outer spacing around the banner for page states where it renders alone in the main area (KumikoScreen "not-found", "loading", etc.).
  testId?: string;
  id?: string; // Set when a `<Field>` wraps this Banner as its control (no actual input exists for the label to target — see render-field.tsx's unsupported-field-type fallback).
};

  bulk?: DataTableProps["bulk"]; // Forwarded to `DataTableProps.bulk` / `rowTone`.
  rowTone?: DataTableProps["rowTone"];
  toolbarActions?: ToolbarActionButton[]; // Toolbar actions in the list header in resolved form.
  filterFacets?: DataTableFacet[]; // Faceted filter dropdowns.
  filterValues?: Readonly<Record<string, string[]>>; // Currently selected facet values by field (from URL state).
  onFilterChange?: (field: string, values: string[]) => void; // Toggles a facet value (sets URL state and refetches).
  onFilterReset?: () => void; // Reset aller aktiven Facets.
  dateRangeFacets?: DataTableDateRangeFacet[]; // Time-range filters — forwarded to the DataTable.
  onDateRangeChange?: (field: string, bound: "from" | "to", value: string) => void; // One bound changed (set URL state + refetch).
  chromeless?: boolean; // Forwarded to `DataTableProps.chromeless` — drops the table's own card frame for a host that already provides one (relatedList in a tabs-mode section).
  scrollBody?: boolean; // Forwarded to `DataTableProps.scrollBody` — bounds the table height and scrolls rows internally instead of growing the page (relatedList in a tabs-mode section).
  screenPadding?: boolean; // Forwarded to `DataTableProps.screenPadding` — `true`: the table carries the shared screen padding because it is the screen body (entityList/ projectionList).
  expandedRowIds?: ReadonlySet<string>; // Forwarded to `DataTableProps.expandedRowIds` / `onToggleRowExpanded` / `renderExpandedRow` (entityList `expandableRow`).
  onToggleRowExpanded?: (rowId: string) => void;
  renderExpandedRow?: (row: ListRowViewModel) => ReactNode;
};
type ResolverComponent = ComponentType<{ target: TargetRef; onClose: () => void; }>;
interface ResultColumn<Row> {
  header: string;
  align?: "left" | "right";
  cell: (row: Row) => ReactNode;
}
type SectionProps = { // Titled group of fields.
  id?: string; // DOM id — the scroll target of a form's "on this page" navigation.
  title?: string; // Optional; without a title, the Section renders only the grouping and no header.
  subtitle?: ReactNode; // Optional muted subtitle below the title, providing section context rather than only a label (analogous to `FormProps.subtitle`).
  children: ReactNode;
  actions?: ReactNode; // Rendered top-right in the title row — never a footer.
  layout?: "stacked" | "settings-list"; // "settings-list": title + subtitle form a left header column and the children (field rows) the right one on `md:` and up.
  variant?: "default" | "destructive"; // "destructive" marks the Section as a warning/danger area (e.g. account deletion, restrict processing) — border color only, no content change.
  testId?: string;
  icon?: IconKey; // Rendered left of the title, `text-muted-foreground`, same optical size as the title.
};
interface SelectFieldProps extends FieldBase {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  options: string[] | { value: string; label: string; }[];
}
type ShadowTokens = {
  card: string;
};
type SideBySideTableCell = {
  content: ReactNode;
  colSpan?: number; // Spans this cell over following columns (a value that is identical on both sides shown once).
};
type SideBySideTableColumn = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
};
type SideBySideTableRow = {
  id: string;
  header: ReactNode;
  cells: SideBySideTableCell[];
  tone?: "warn"; // Highlights a row that needs attention (e.g. differing values).
};
type SidebarBrandProps = {
  name: string; // Workspace/app name (bold, first line).
  plan?: string; // Second line — plan, tagline, or tenant (small, dimmed).
  logo?: ReactNode; // The tile typically contains a Lucide icon.
  collapsible?: boolean; // Shows the ChevronsUpDown icon only when the app wraps the brand in a dropdown.
};
type SidebarProps = {
  header?: ReactNode; // Header area at the top — typically a workspace avatar, name, and badge.
  actions?: ReactNode; // Action cluster between the header and nav — typically a "+ Neu" button and search icon.
  children: ReactNode; // NavTree and free-form sections (e.g. "Your teams" header and sub-items).
  footer?: ReactNode; // Footer area at the bottom — typically an invite link, help, and plan banner.
  testId?: string;
};
type SidebarUserProps = {
  name: string;
  email?: string;
  avatar?: string; // Avatar URL.
};
type SpacingTokens = {
  card: string;
};
type StatDelta = {
  value: string;
  direction: "up" | "down";
  tone?: StatTone;
};
type StatTone = DashboardStatTone;
type StatusBadgeTone = StatusTone | "accent"; // `accent` is a brand-colored call-out (e.g. "3 suggestions"), not a status — hence not part of `StatusTone`, which toasts and select options share.
type StatusBarEntry = {
  key: string; // Stable key (z.B.
  level: number; // Bar height from 0 to 1 (e.g. operational=1, degraded=0.75, outage=0.25).
  tone: StatusTone;
  label?: string; // Tooltip text (<title>), supplied translated by the caller.
};
type StatusTone = "ok" | "warn" | "bad" | "critical" | "muted";
type StepAction = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost";
  disabled?: boolean;
  pending?: boolean;
};
type StepListItem = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  status: StepStatus;
  lockedReason?: string; // Shown for "locked" as muted tag "Wartet auf: ..." and as the icon's accessible name.
  tags?: StepTag[];
  meta?: string;
  link?: {
    label: string;
    href?: string;
    onClick?: () => void;
    placement?: "trailing" | "below"; // "below" puts an action that changes the step (e.g. taking a rejection back) under its text; default is the trailing link to what the step made.
  };
  sources?: StepSource[]; // Where the step comes from, e.g. "Quelle: Seite 3, § 5" (caller-localized); each renders as a link under the description.
  highlighted?: boolean; // Marks the step the reader is looking at (warm background).
  actions?: StepAction[]; // Rendered only while status is "open".
};
type StepListProps = {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string; // Second line under the title, e.g. who completed the list and when.
  status?: {
    label: string;
    tone: StatusBadgeTone;
  }; // Badge next to the title, e.g. "Erledigt" for a finished list.
  steps: StepListItem[];
  footerActions?: StepAction[]; // Footer row: a ghost action for the whole list next to the primary next-step action.
  collapsedAfter?: number; // Show only the first n steps plus "und k weitere Schritte" (expands on click).
  surface?: "ai" | "plain"; // "ai" (default) = AiSurface background, "plain" = no background.
  fill?: boolean; // Stretch to the container height: steps scroll in the middle, the footer stays pinned at the bottom.
  progress?: "full" | "count" | "none"; // "full" (default) = "x von y erledigt" plus bar, "count" = only the count, "none" = neither, e.g. when `status` already says the list is done.
  emptyContent?: ReactNode;
  phoneCard?: boolean; // On a phone the list reads as a card: the header sits inside the surface and the steps in a framed white box.
  testId?: string;
};
type StepSource = {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
};
type StepStatus = "done" | "open" | "locked" | "running" | "rejected" | "failed";
type StepTag = {
  label: string;
  tone?: "accent" | "muted" | "warn" | "ok" | "bad";
  afterWaiting?: boolean; // A note about the step's history (e.g. just changed) reads after what it waits for.
};
interface TextFieldProps extends FieldBase {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  placeholder?: string;
  autoComplete?: string;
}
type TextProps = { // Semantic text.
  variant?: "body" | "small" | "code" | "required-mark" | "muted";
  decorative?: boolean; // Pure ornament (e.g. a separator glyph): hidden from assistive tech.
  children: ReactNode;
  testId?: string;
};
interface TextareaFieldProps extends FieldBase {
  value: string;
  onChange: (v: string) => void;
  rows?: number;
}
type ThemeMenuItemProps = {
  lightIcon?: ReactNode;
  darkIcon?: ReactNode;
  autoIcon?: ReactNode;
  titleInDark?: string;
  titleInLight?: string;
  titleForAuto?: string;
  testId?: string;
};
type ThemeMode = "light" | "dark";
type ThemePreference = ThemeMode | "auto"; // "auto" follows the OS color scheme live; light/dark are explicit choices.
type ThemeToggleProps = {
  lightIcon?: ReactNode; // Icon for the step to light mode.
  darkIcon?: ReactNode; // Icon for the step to dark mode.
  autoIcon?: ReactNode; // Icon for the step to auto mode.
  titleInDark?: string; // Title/aria-label for the step to light mode.
  titleInLight?: string; // Title/aria-label for the step to dark mode.
  titleForAuto?: string; // Title/aria-label for the step to auto mode.
  testId?: string;
};
type ThreadMessage = {
  id: string;
  author: string; // "Anna Schneider" or the caller's "Du".
  address?: string;
  direction: "incoming" | "outgoing"; // Outgoing messages get the reply icon in the collapsed row.
  timeLabel: string; // Preformatted by the caller ("Heute 09:41").
  body: MessageBody;
  attachments?: MessageAttachment[];
};
type TimeseriesHeight = // Pixel height, or one height per viewport class.
  | number
  | {
    narrow: number;
    wide: number;
    narrowBelowPx?: number;
  }
;
type TimeseriesPoint = {
  atMs: number;
  value: number | null; // null = outage/no value → falls to the baseline for a visible drop.
};
type TimeseriesReferenceLine = {
  value: number; // Same unit as the point values (e.g. a p95 or SLO threshold in ms).
  label: string; // Translated by the caller.
  tone?: StatusTone;
};
type TimeseriesXAxis = {
  ticks: number; // Number of evenly spaced time labels (min 2).
  format: (atMs: number) => string;
};
type TimeseriesYAxis = {
  ticks: number; // Number of gridlines including the zero baseline (min 2).
  format?: (value: number) => string; // Label text per tick value (unit, locale).
  unit?: string; // Ready-to-display unit (e.g. "ms"), shown once above the tick labels so `format` can stay unit-free.
};
type ToastOptions = {
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  variant?: ToastVariant;
  docsUrl?: string;
  docsLinkLabel?: string;
  requestId?: string;
};
type ToastProviderProps = {
  children: ReactNode;
};
type ToastVariant = StatusTone;
type Tokens = CoreTokens & AppTokens;
type TokensApi = {
  tokens: Tokens;
  mode: ThemeMode; // The scheme currently applied (resolved from the preference when it is "auto").
  preference?: ThemePreference; // Optional so hand-built TokensApi values (tests, custom providers) stay valid: absent means a plain light/dark implementation, read as `mode`.
  setPreference?: (preference: ThemePreference) => void;
  setMode: (mode: ThemeMode) => void; // Explicit choice: leaves "auto".
  toggleMode: () => void; // Explicit flip of the resolved mode: leaves "auto".
};
type TokensProviderProps = {

};
type TopbarProps = {

};
type TranslationBundle = Readonly<Record<string, TranslationValue>>; // Map of i18n key → TranslationValue.
type TranslationsByLocale = Readonly<Record<string, TranslationBundle>>; // Map from locale code (BCP-47, e.g. `"de"`, `"en-US"`) → bundle.
type UploadZoneProps = {

  title: ReactNode;

};
